messages:
Ravi: Heads up — proposing to unpin runtime v2.30.0 for a limited night window (00:45 UTC) to pick up the new kernel-affinity improvements. Tagging @Lena for SDK/contract sanity and @Ops for rollback prep.
Lena: Do we have an SDK rollout that aligns? SDK 4.0.0-beta changed content-negotiation for embeddings; need a quick contract run.
QA-Bot: Quick contract run queued: test-suite 'embed-contracts' -> running against runtime:v2.30.0 and modelpool:canary. ETA ~6m.
Ops: Preparing pinback routes and a scoped toggle. We'll keep legacy route ready: routing/legacy-embed-toggle.yaml. Ops also recommends excluding old-kernel hosts from first cohort.
Deploybot: Roll window scheduled: 2026-04-02T00:45:00Z cohorts: 4% -> 20% -> 60% -> 100%, step=20m. Auto-guards: error_rate, p95, embed-contract.
Ravi: Rollback triggers: error_rate > 1% sustained 5m OR embed-contract failure OR any unhandled native crash. Manual abort allowed by Ops.
QA-Bot: 00:40 UTC — embed-contract run: 2 failures detected (accept header mismatch). Details logged in CI job 4678.
Lena: Those failures match the SDK change. I can push a lightweight ingress shim to normalize Accept headers; will open PR and request hotpatch.
Ops: Shim ready in staging (PR #1122). Patch path for prod if needed:
```
kubectl apply -f ingress/shims/accept-normalize.yaml --context=prod
```
Ravi: Good. Keep an eye on kvcache cold-start telemetry — previous runtime changes had warmup differences. Add kvcache metric to canary dashboard.
Deploybot: Canary cohort 4% started: region=eu-west-1 hosts=8 (automated).
Ops: 00:52 UTC — minor uptick in 502s on 2 hosts, likely shim timing. Increasing proxy timeout and redeploying proxy config.
Lena: 00:58 UTC — embed-contract probe still shows occasional mismatch, applying ingress shim to cohort hosts only.
Deploybot: Ingress shim applied to cohort hosts (automated).
QA-Bot: 01:02 UTC — embed-contract checks passing after shim.
Ravi: If contract passes for the next 10m, proceed to 20% at 01:05. Keep rollback steps at hand.
Deploybot: Proceeding to 20% cohort (automated). region=eu-west-1 + us-east-1 hosts=34.
Ops: 01:14 UTC — one host restarted due to out-of-memory during heap growth on long-context tests, flagged but not OOM. Marking host for exclusion from further cohorts.
Lena: Logging an action item: backport Accept-normalize to SDK gateway and add integration test to prevent regressions.
Deploybot: Health monitor reported error_rate=1.3% sustained for 6m in us-east-1. Auto-pinback triggered: routing for affected cohorts -> runtime:v2.29 (automated).
Ravi: Acknowledged pinback. Opening ticket ENG-5500 to triage memory growth + shim timing. Include heap profiles and proxy traces.
Ops: Rollback commands used (for record):
```
kubectl apply -f routing/pinback-v2-29.yaml --context=prod
deploybot cancel --id=2955555555 --scope=canary
```
Lena: I'll prepare a short customer note about temporary embed behavior and the legacy route workaround.
Ravi: Thanks everyone — we’ll analyze ENG-5500, land the ingress shim backport, and schedule a narrower follow-up window once we have fixes. :thumbsup:
